sn23.20:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Rādho Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Vayadhammo vayadhammoti bhante vuccati || || Katamo nu kho bhante vayadhammoti || || Rūpaṃ kho Rādha vayadhammo || vedanā vayadhammo || saññā || saṅkhārā vayadhammo || viññāṇaṃ vayadhammo || || Evam passaṃ || pe || nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || || Sāvatthi || ||
